name: Profit
overview: Scripture teaches that true profit is not found in worldly riches or possessions, as treasures gained by wickedness or wealth cannot deliver us from death or judgment. Instead, righteousness is the only lasting profit that brings deliverance, emphasizing the eternal value of the soul over material gain. The Scriptures warn against gaining the whole world at the cost of one's soul, highlighting the futility of earthly profit without spiritual well-being. Additionally, faithful labor yields profit, while mere talk leads to poverty, and the early church's example of sharing possessions underscores the importance of generosity and community over personal accumulation.
